title: Mixed Event — Singing in Sync

meta.Outline: As Vivid BAD SQUAD takes its first steps, An and Kohane are both fully confident that they have the best partner in one another. However, the two partners quickly find themselves hitting a snag. Will they be able to get through it?!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright! Now that we're all here, let's talk about our plans for the future.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You wanted to discuss what kinds of events Vivid BAD SQUAD should be in next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, it's like we're a real team now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do you mean like a real team?
We ARE a real team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, we need to decide what sorts of events to gear up for as a group from now on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, the BAD DOGS and Vivids have completely different styles so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should find something that's a good fit for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been thinking about what would be good for us, but there are just so many choices.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Are there that many different types of events?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
You've only done invitational ones before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The events that are held around here broadly fall into one of two categories.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: First, you have invitation-based ones, where a venue asks certain artists to perform.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's what we did as the Vivids.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was a little overwhelming at first, but everyone was so friendly that I forgot about being anxious really quickly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, those events are organized among friends, so they're pretty laidback. The other event category is battles.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
B-Battles?!
You fight each other?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha, kind of but it's pretty standard.
Groups perform and compete for the audience's votes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The group that gets the audience fired up the most wins. Pretty simple, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Competitive events are more intense...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But treating one another with respect is very important in this kind of community, so you don't need to stress.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The rules can differ based on the venue too. We can look into details after picking an event to go for.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see, they are different from what I've done... But they sound fun too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right? And now there's four of us, it's totally worth giving them a try.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your order's ready!
Two coffees and two cafes au lait.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you so much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Great aroma as always.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I also brought you some cookies. I'm thinking about adding them to the menu. Please, try them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, they look yummy...!
All for free... Are you really sure?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, of course.
I hope you like them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, how's your discussion going? All good?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so.
We're trying to decide which events to be in next.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, STAY GOLDEN is coming up. That one's a battle event, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. RUST played at the last one, and everyone went wild when they were on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are they that good?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're top tier! They did RAD WEEKEND together with my dad's group. All of their songs are awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, sounds like you really look up to them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm, I guess I do. It'd be great to sing at an event featuring them too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, you know what...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We should enter STAY GOLDEN!
How's that sound?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The best groups all participate, so it'd be a real trial by fire for us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We could give it a go, and try to turn more heads than RUST did last time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Go big or go home!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Playing as guests at our last event was fun, but it's more satisfying to be competing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all excited about it... But it's going to be a big challenge for me. I have zero experience with this sort of event.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Kohane?
You seem a little tense...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you're worried about something, maybe I can offer some advice?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm fine! I was just lost in my thoughts for a moment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Is that so?
I must have misread your expression.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes... I'm sorry for causing a fuss over nothing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I am honestly a bit anxious, but if my friends are with me... I'm sure it'll work out...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Besides, I've performed in front of an audience many times now. It can't be that much different...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An! I'm going to give this event everything I've got!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great! You're gonna do fine.
I mean, the audience loved you at our last show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! It's still a little intimidating, but I'll try to sing just like I did then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Have more confidence, girl. You're a mind-blowing singer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear how it goes for you. I'll be rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, will do!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How about we practice today to start work on our event routine? Is everybody okay with going to the park as usual?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome to use the stage at my cafe, if you like.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't mind?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course.
It's all yours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
MEIKO... Thank you so much!
We'll put it to good use!
A few days later
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: STAY GOLDEN's tomorrow! I hope you're pumped up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wanna do a full rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright. I'll count us in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kay! Whenever you're ready, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's go. One, two, three, four!
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The four of us sync up so well!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's really got a great voice...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (With this much talent, it makes no sense for her to lack confidence.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Maybe she's afraid of making a mistake because she's inexperienced...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But even if she did slip up, we'd be there to pick her back up and keep going!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We've improved a lot.
I think we're good to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Agreed. We've nailed everything down.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really like singing with you guys. I'm having so much fun, it's making my heart race!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't see us not winning STAY GOLDEN!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we can't let our guard down. We can always use more practice!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing. We've set our sights not just on winning the event, but also putting on something bigger than RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um... I can't help feeling anxious...
Imagining all the things that could go wrong...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've got nothing to worry about, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In the unlikely event that something does go wrong, I'll cover for you and get you back on track, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why are you saying that to her?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Something wrong, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, forget it... Are you two...? Well, nevermind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An. You can be sure that I'm going to give this show everything I have!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know you will! If you ever get lost, just focus on my voice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Hehe. It's good to know you've got my back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha, of course I do! We're a team!
The day of the show
STAY GOLDEN Venue

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow, it's so packed...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place is buzzing with energy! If I weren't already fired up for this, I'd definitely be now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How can they be unfazed by all this...?)

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line:
Hey! Akito, Toya!
You guys gonna be okay against this lineup?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pfft... Dude, we're gonna make fans from other groups come flock to us instead.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It doesn't matter who we're up against. We're not losing to anyone!

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: An! Good luck! I'll be cheering for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! This is gonna be our best show ever! Get ready for a wild ride!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow, An and the guys are already well-known here. I need to do a good job today to get my name out there too.)

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Hey, it's Kohane! I saw you at your other gig. Keep it up, girl!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Er... Thank you, I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The other contestants all have solid reputations...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we've got Vivid and BAD DOGS fans cheering for us today! This feels awesome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Hey! We're about to get this show rolling, so let's hear some noise!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's go and sing our hearts out!
We'll make the audience go crazy for us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Coming up next is EVER, a strong favorite in today's battle!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did you guys feel that just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... They only just started, but everyone's already being blown away...

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Your awesome cheers are music to our ears! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Lots of folks are saying we're favorites and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: But hey, we don't wanna discourage the guys singing after us. They could be some hot stuff too, who knows, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Leader of EVER
rows.Line: Show us what you got!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What a performance...!
They just sent this place sky high!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're the ones who're gonna make the audience really explode.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're really quiet, Kohane. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to sing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to get on that stage and sing...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...
Yeah, don't we all!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Guys, get ready. We're next.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Let's do our best, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're winning this one! No doubt about it!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next is Vivid BAD SQUAD, a group of four high schoolers. They're a new name on the scene, but already creating a huge buzz!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, hey, hey! Thank you for coming!
We're Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: C'mon, make some noise! Are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're starting off with a good vibe...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (All that's left is to sing our hearts out...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line: These guys are amazing!

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: These guys are high schoolers?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We nailed the intro!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Great, Kohane seems to be enjoying it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We've got the audience hooked. So far so good!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, hey! So you like our songs? That was just a warm-up! Now, we're gonna kick it up a notch!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That was good...
I've gotta step it up too!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We can't let Shiraishi just leave us in the back!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow...! The crowd's so fired up, I'm starting to feel it too!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An, Aoyagi and Shinonome are really awesome! I have to do my best to keep up!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, what's happening? I can't sing as well as when we were rehearsing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, I get it. It's because the audience is so loud, it's drowning out everyone's voices!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do I do...?! This is bad...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's no use... I can't hear An clearly enough...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (What's up with Kohane...?!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She missed her cue...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(The next part's the most important...!
We'll have to sing it without her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, we can't leave Kohane behind...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm gonna help her!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's An doing?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This is bad... If An backs up Kohane, the chorus is gonna lose its punch!)

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line:
Hey, what's going on...?
Don't they sound off all the sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Yeah, they were so good until just now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No...! We're at the end of the song...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In the unlikely event that something does go wrong, I'll cover for you and get you back on track, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I couldn't do anything to help...!)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: That was Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line:
That's a weak applause, but it figures.
They totally fell apart at the end.

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Yeah, but they were pretty good for most of it...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, who can rev up this event more than EVER?! Let's see what our next contestants have to offer!
After the show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I said I'd get Kohane back on track if anything happened, but I failed...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's my fault we messed up that song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I slipped up too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was too focused on working the crowd and missed my chance to back up Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who'd have thought we'd screw up like that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... Just gotta make sure everything goes like clockwork next time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, you're all wrong...
It was all my fault.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I couldn't keep up and ended up throwing you off all your parts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No! Don't blame yourself, Kohane! That was your first battle event and I should've done more to help you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, you did all you could.
It was going so well... I'm really sorry, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, um... I'll get us all something to drink.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, wait...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's my fault...
I should've helped her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I failed as her partner... I couldn't protect her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Protect her...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, she's my partner... And I wanted to guide her so that she could sing without worrying...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I knew something was up. Now I get why what you said the other day didn't vibe with me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't think of Kohane as one of the team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...? Where's that coming from...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You feel like you have to protect her...
Look after her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, wait...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: During our rehearsal, you talked about covering for her and getting her back on track, and thought that you were just trying to be helpful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what you really meant was that you saw her as someone who can't be one of us without your special help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't see Kohane as a full-fledged member of our squad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you think you need to look after her, it means she's a helpless dependent in your eyes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I couldn't do it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I couldn't protect her...
Even after saying that I'd help her.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-No.... But... That would mean that ever since we started this group, I wasn't being fair to her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The last group should be done by now.
Let's go back...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was I not treating Kohane as an equal...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I kept telling her to be confident... That I'd cover for her as if she couldn't have done it without me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I... I have to apologize to her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to tell her that I realized my mistake...!
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I thought I could sing in front of an audience without any problems, but I couldn't have been more wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I missed my part and ruined everything because of that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was so sure that I'd be okay because my friends were there with me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it's my fault for becoming too relaxed and thinking I could just rely on An if something went wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (H-Have I been relying on her too much...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Listen, I owe you an apology.
What I said earlier about covering for you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, please don't... There's no need for you to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like I said, it's all my own fault. This wouldn't have happened if I just kept up with you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, Kohane...! It's not that you weren't...
I caused all of this by not treating you like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, I promise to do better next time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The event is almost over...
We should go back inside for the results.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...
STAY GOLDEN Venue

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: And the winner is... EVER!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Their unbelievable performance and energy just trumped everyone else's!

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member
rows.Line: The last time we did this with RUST was awesome too, but today was phenomenal!

rows.Speaker: Female Audience Member
rows.Line: Everyone knew EVER would win right from the start.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Let's invite the winners onto the stage...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's all over so quickly...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have to talk about what happened today and make sure it never does again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Are you spacing out, An?
Did you hear what I just said?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that we need to talk about what happened today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, this is gonna be a long one...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's hold off on it today. We can talk tomorrow during practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, bye...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: See you tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess, I'll leave too then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, I didn't finish what I was saying earlier...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you for today, An.
We can talk tomorrow... Bye.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Male Singer A
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD just talked big and crashed hard!

rows.Speaker: Male Singer B
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't see them ever getting anywhere near what RAD WEEKEND was.

rows.Speaker: Male Singer A
rows.Line: I guess.

rows.Speaker: Male Singer B
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm glad I got to see EVER live. They were unreal! They blurred the line between the stage and the audience, and got everyone involved!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't see Kohane as a full-fledged member of our squad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I... I feel awful...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Were you doing a performance today too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we were in an event today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's rare to see you this down though. The last time you were like this was when Sports Day got canceled when we were kids.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha, is that something to say to a childhood friend in need? Besides, I get sad like anyone else sometimes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what's wrong? Are you sick or something...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing like that!
Just...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's because of something that happened today...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, in a nutshell, you've been babying Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And after someone pointed out that you haven't been treating her like an equal, you're feeling down?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When you say it like that, Haruka, it makes me feel even worse...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But it's exactly like that.
I always felt that I had to protect Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was so narrow-minded that I was convinced myself it would be for the best, for both me and her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And yes, I'm feeling down...
But more than that, I'm angry with myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But you care about her, right?
And you want her to stay in your group?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I think you should have a heart-to-heart with Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you won't experience what I did, when I ended up hurting a friend because I couldn't communicate my feelings clearly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? What's that mean?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember when I left ASRUN...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There were a lot of rumors floating around, but the real reason I quit was because I failed to help a group member who needed it really badly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So that's what happened...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've patched things up since then and are friends again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I keep kicking myself for not being more honest with her from the start, so that we wouldn't have had a falling out in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It made me realize the importance of being upfront with the people who are close to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I should stop bottling up my thoughts and just let them all out?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That suits you more than me anyway, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I feel a lot better.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You take care, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You too, bye!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've got to be more candid, huh...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back... Oh, Dad's gone out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The bar won't open for a while, so I could tidy up a little. Maybe practice a little too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is where Kohane and I sang together for the first time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, let's team up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's sweep the world off its feet with our performances!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I still have a lot to learn...but I still want to work toward that goal together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I invited Kohane to sing with me, and we did our first gig together after that.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was amazed by how talented she was.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(With her, we'd surpass RAD WEEKEND...
Or so I thought...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We had a rough start, but Kohane was enthusiastic about singing with me and determined to make this group work.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Only, she never had enough confidence in herself. Her singing was incredible, but she tended to worry a lot.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She'd always turn to me and ask me for advice. When a gig went well, she'd be so happy...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How could I've been so blind...?
I enjoyed having Kohane relying on me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I used to pursue my dreams alone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then Kohane came along and I was so happy to sing with her, and have her rely on me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm such an idiot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was so happy to have a sidekick, I became too overbearing and let it affect our performance...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I failed her... I failed my partner...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I should've believed in her and helped her grow...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I did just the exact opposite...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, you did all you could.
It was going so well... I'm really sorry, everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I won't let Kohane feel that ashamed ever again...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: From now on, I'll treat her as my equal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to clear things up with her, so we can finally become a real team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
If I don't...
I don't deserve to sing with her.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sob...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I just can't catch up to the others...
I still feel so awful about yesterday too...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Maybe more practice might help...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But what exactly should I be working on? I don't think I can make progress with just singing practice.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sigh... I don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, let's have lunch together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no, is something wrong?! You don't look so good... Should we go see the nurse?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh, no. I'm fine. I was just thinking about something, and forgot it was lunchtime.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, if there's something on your mind, you can tell me. I can't promise I'll be of much help but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If there's anything I can do, I will! I want to help you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Maybe I should get it off my chest.
You see, yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I keep thinking that if I wasn't so inexperienced, we would've done well at this event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have thoughts like that too from time to time, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, you know that I'm in an idol group, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm the only one with no experience in the business.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I kept failing auditions, and I'm not all that good at singing or dancing. I feel like a fifth wheel sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That must be very difficult for you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So I get anxious, thinking I have to do better.
Just like you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I try to stay optimistic and no matter how many times I fail, I believe that tomorrow will be a better day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's something Haruka told you, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, and I've taken her words to heart!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They motivate me to keep working on my singing and dancing, to believe that I'll see a difference tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That today's efforts will pave the way to a better future!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Today's efforts will pave the way to a better future...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I have Haruka, Airi and Shizuku giving me pointers for my practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's more fun and I think I'm also making better progress with the more experienced members tutoring me, instead of trying to get better on my own.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... It makes sense that people who've been doing this for a long time know the best ways to practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly. We're still rookies, but we have other group members that we can rely on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So let's keep asking them for advice!
We just have to keep trying our best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha, I don't know if that sounded really cool or really cheesy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It wasn't cheesy at all! Thank you, Minori!
I see the light at the end of the tunnel now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe, I'm happy to hear that!
Oh, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have some fried chicken in my lunch box today. I'll give you a piece!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My mom's fried chicken has the power to cheer people up! I also have some eggs and potato salad if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We both need to eat so we can keep trying more!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You don't have to give me so much!
You won't have any left to eat yourself!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But thank you, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Should I ask my group members what I need to work on? But I've been such a bother to them so much already...)
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: HEY!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...? What is it, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's lunchtime. You're getting anything to eat?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I was lost in my thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is it about Shiraishi and Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I was wondering how I could help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi seemed really shaken the other day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Shaken?
That girl is not that fragile.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If she couldn't deal with a bit of reality, she wouldn't have created this group.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's that look supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nothing. You really believe in her, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Would I team up with someone I didn't believe in?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You can't work as a team if you don't believe in one another. Even more so if you're partners.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She'll get over this and figure out what she has to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose you're right...
After School
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Homeroom ended earlier than I expected...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What should I do until our meetup time...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're still rookies, but we have other group members that we can rely on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So let's keep asking them for advice!
We just have to keep trying our best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Should I really turn to them for help...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you're worried about something, maybe I can offer some advice?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, right...!)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane. Welcome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Tell me about your event.
How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's exactly what I came here for...
Yesterday was a disaster because of me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We may've had a chance of winning if I only managed to sing properly...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone's hard work was all wasted because of me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really want to improve and stay in the group, but I just don't know what I should be doing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I already talked about this with a friend earlier and she gave me some advice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She said I should ask those with more experience for pointers. That I can learn a lot from them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very thoughtful of your friend.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes...! Which is why I thought that maybe I should ask you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: My, I'm flattered.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But didn't your friend mean that you should ask the other members of your team?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're in this together, so I'm sure they'll hear you out. And look at that! One of them has just arrived...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: One of them...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hm, Aoyagi...?
It's rare to see you here alone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I like to get here early to enjoy a cup of coffee before we start practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, I'll go and make you one. In the meantime, maybe you could help Kohane with something that's been on her mind?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What would that be?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. She'll tell you herself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh, well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really don't want something like yesterday to happen again, so... Could you please tell me how I should be practicing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi... How did you practice to get to this point?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Practice, huh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It wasn't so much practice as performing in public that helped me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you think is the biggest difference between complete novices and seasoned veterans...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Isn't it how much time they've spent practicing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's one factor too, but I think it's the number of times they've performed in front of an audience.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The number of times they've performed...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Good technique and innate talent can mask having practiced less to some degree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it all becomes clear when someone doesn't have that many actual performances under their belt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before Akito and I teamed up, I used to join other groups at their gigs or even sing with them when they were practicing in public.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wanted to gain experience singing in front of people any way I could, knowing that it would help me with my own gigs in time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm not sure if I can do that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Whether or not you want to try this way is up to you, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I get anxious just from the thought of singing with people I don't know but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really want to sing with An... With Vivid BAD SQUAD! So I'll do all I can!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sounds like you've made up your mind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, Shiraishi seemed really down yesterday over the way she's been treating you until now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think you two should talk to her, clear things up and maybe make her feel a little better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I didn't know...
Thank you. I'll be sure to do that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for pointing me in the right direction, Aoyagi. And sorry about yesterday... And bothering you today with my questions...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You asked me because our group really matters to you and you want to improve, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I don't mind helping you out. You're my teammate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also want the four of us to stay together. Akito thinks so too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to catch up to the others as soon as possible... No, not just catch up. I need to be more ambitious...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's good to see you in high spirits again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you like some more tea?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, please!
Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to apologize to Kohane... Properly too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm, Akito?
You're early today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: School finished early so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I should say thank you, for yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you... For what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You opened my eyes to the fact I was holding Kohane back by being so overprotective.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I want to say thank you for that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Meh, it wasn't a big deal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Stop acting so cool and just accept my thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Honestly, I'm nervous about telling her how I thought she needed my guidance and protection...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this is something I have to do if we're gonna stick together. Even if she gets angry with me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I don't have the courage to do this, it'll mean I don't deserve to share the stage with her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think we have the potential to outshine RAD WEEKEND, but I have to apologize to Kohane and patch things up with her before we can do that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, huh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two are pretty early...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Or are we the late ones...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, we got here ahead of time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm so sorry about yesterday!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the things I said about covering for you... I've been so overprotective this whole time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito made me realize that I wasn't treating you fairly, like an equal...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I used to perform solo with the goal of surpassing RAD WEEKEND in mind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For the longest time, I couldn't find anyone who I thought had it in them to join me on this path... Until you came along.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're an awesome singer, Kohane. I want to keep performing with you and realize that dream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I believe all of this, even now. Especially now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When you weren't sure about something, you leaned on me and asked me for advice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That made me really happy.
And I didn't want that to end...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it ended with yesterday happening...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I failed you as your partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I should've believed in you more and helped you grow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I want us to be together, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want us to perform together! I want to be your partner!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I want you to believe in us too!
Because I really believe in you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So please, will you sing with me on that stage again?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, of course...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You don't have to blame yourself for yesterday. It's a fact that I just wasn't able to sing until the very end.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It wasn't right for me to be so reliant on you too, but I didn't know what to do now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I talked to different friends about it and they all assured me that I'll improve as long as I work at it. That I'll eventually be able to pull my own weight.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I want to go beyond that. I want to be a fully-fledged member of this group, who proudly sings with you, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I want the four of us to realize our dream together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If I got the crowd as fired up as the rest of you did at the event yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure we would've had the best performance there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It might take me some time before I stop falling behind or slipping up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I want nothing more than to keep singing with you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah... Yeah!
Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
W-Wait, An?!
I wasn't prepared for a hug...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm so happy, I couldn't help it...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
See.
Told you they'd sort it out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed, you were right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, did you say something to her?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I gave her some advice as a teammate. That's all...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So which event should we go for next?
I brought a few flyers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, there are so many to choose from...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And they all look awesome!
I don't know which one to pick.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then how about... This one?
An outdoor gig at Miyamasuzaka next month?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An outdoor gig... This one draws a big crowd and features really good groups too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And performing outside could be nice for a change.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sounds like everyone's in!
I'll sign us up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that we know what we're doing, let's start preparing for it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, everyone. Would you mind if Rin and Len joined your practice sessions?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've been telling me how much they'd really like to sing with you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, no problem!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. They should be here soon with Miku.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Hey, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I miss a cue at the next event...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Could you cover for me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
Sure, I can do that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, partner! I'm countin' on ya!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. They're becoming a good team.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Something tells me that they'll make their dreams come true too.)
